Title: CookieConsent
Description: Easily add a configurable cookie consent banner to your site. Features include a dashboard for customization of behavior, appearance, and translations.

Screenshots.Caption: Consent banner and preferences modal with per-category cookie details
Dashboard: choose the categories shown in the banner, whether visitors can change them, and the language
Built-in scripts: add Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager or Facebook Pixel with Consent Mode handled for you
